sloka: हतवीरप्रधानां हि हतौत्साहा निरुद्यमा ।सेना भ्रमति सङ्ख्येषु हतकर्णेव नौर्जले ।। ६.४८.२७ ।।।।
transliteration: hatavīrapradhānāṁ hi hatautsāhā nirudyamā ।senā bhramati saṅkhyeṣu hatakarṇeva naurjale ।। 6.48.27 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Lady, given to austerities! These monkeys are guarding Kakuthsa as proclaimed by me lovingly. Do not be confused. They are safe."
